## Appearance

Morgan is a short, stout lady. She has gray hair and wears a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

A kindhearted individual and a delightful conversationalist, she easily wins the affection and admiration of others. Having traveled extensively, she is also an excellent storyteller.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Morgan is a well-traveled author who has written extensively about girls and is known for her excellent storytelling. After an initial visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was delayed due to a sprained ankle, she later visited [Anne](../character/anne.md) along with [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), enjoying a lovely dinner and a walk through the surrounding woods. She also owned a larger property in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) eventually proposed buying to accommodate his and Anne's growing family.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P13](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0013), +94 more_

## Relationships

### [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--pendexter.md)

Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) is an acquaintance of Morgan who travels alongside her as a guest. She visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in the company of Morgan and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), where they are entertained with a dinner and a tour of the local woods.

- Friend of — friend visiting together  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Morgan's niece who also acts as her travelling companion. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arranges visits for her famous aunt, including writing to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Morgan's schedule when a sprained ankle delays a planned trip, and later accompanying Morgan and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) on their afternoon visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
